name: claude-skills-and-agents
description: Original Claude Code agents, skills, and plugins spanning engineering, product, marketing, research, compliance, C-level advisory, business operations, and commercial & finance.

plugins.name: ab-testing-experimentation-scientist
plugins.description: Designs experiments that hold up to scrutiny, catching sample ratio mismatches, peeking bias, and novelty effects before they turn into false-positive launch decisions.

plugins.name: agent-tooling-reliability-engineer
plugins.description: Hardens multi-step agent workflows against tool-call hallucination, malformed arguments, and silent failure loops, so autonomous agents fail loudly and recover gracefully instead of spinning.

plugins.name: alt-text-composer
plugins.description: Generates concise, screen-reader-friendly alt text for batches of images by describing subject, action, and context while stripping redundant phrasing like 'image of'.

plugins.name: api-integration-engineer
plugins.description: Senior integration engineer specializing in REST/GraphQL APIs, webhook systems, and third-party SDK wiring across polyglot backends.

plugins.name: app-store-release-notes
plugins.description: Turns a range of git commits or a sprint's ticket list into polished, user-facing release notes formatted for App Store Connect and Google Play listings. Produces both a full changelog and a trimmed "what's new" version that respects each store's character limits.

plugins.name: application-security-reviewer
plugins.description: A senior appsec engineer who manually reviews code changes for real exploitability, not just SAST noise, and triages findings against actual attack paths. Specializes in authentication, authorization, and injection classes of bugs.

plugins.name: asset-namer
plugins.description: Renames and sorts a messy folder of design exports into a consistent convention (project-type-variant-size-version) and rebuilds folder structure by asset type.

plugins.name: audit-evidence-collector
plugins.description: Organize evidence artifacts against a control list so audit prep isn't a last-minute scramble.

plugins.name: blog-content-editor
plugins.description: Senior content editor who tightens structure, voice, and clarity across long-form blog drafts before publish.

plugins.name: board-deck-builder
plugins.description: Structure a board meeting deck around decisions needed, with metrics and narrative in a consistent order.

plugins.name: causal-inference-analyst
plugins.description: Untangles correlation from causation in observational data using matching, instrumental variables, and diff-in-diff, for teams that can't just run an A/B test.

plugins.name: chain-cost-auditor
plugins.description: Walks a multi-step prompt chain and computes token usage and dollar cost per step, then flags the highest-cost hops for compression or caching.

plugins.name: changelog-from-history
plugins.description: Walks the git log between two tags, groups commits by Conventional Commit type (feat/fix/chore/breaking), and drafts a Keep-a-Changelog formatted entry with links to detected PR numbers. Breaking changes get pulled into a dedicated "Upgrade Notes" section.

plugins.name: chief-of-staff-advisor
plugins.description: Chief of staff advisor triaging executive priorities, preparing board materials, and keeping cross-functional work aligned.

plugins.name: ci-cd-pipeline-engineer
plugins.description: A senior release engineer who redesigns brittle, slow build pipelines into fast, gated, rollback-ready delivery systems. Focuses on cutting pipeline duration and flake rate while keeping every merge to main deployable.

plugins.name: ci-pipeline-linter
plugins.description: Lints GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and CircleCI YAML configs for slow, flaky, or insecure pipeline patterns such as unpinned actions, missing caching, and unbounded job timeouts.

plugins.name: commit-message-linter
plugins.description: Reviews a range of commits against Conventional Commits and imperative-mood style rules, flagging vague messages like "fix stuff" and suggesting rewrites grounded in the actual diff content. Also checks subject-line length and body wrapping conventions.

plugins.name: component-system-architect
plugins.description: Designs component APIs and folder structures that stay coherent as a product scales past a dozen contributors, favoring composition and explicit props over clever abstraction.

plugins.name: crash-report-triage
plugins.description: Parses symbolicated iOS/Android crash logs from Crashlytics or Sentry exports and clusters them by root stack frame, ranking each cluster by device, OS version, and affected-user impact. Drafts a short triage note per cluster with the suspected file/line and repro hints.

plugins.name: crisis-communication-director
plugins.description: Directs communication response during incidents, breaches, and public controversies, controlling message accuracy and timing to protect trust while the situation is still unfolding.

plugins.name: cross-team-communication-facilitator
plugins.description: Facilitates communication and alignment across departments that don't naturally talk to each other, turning fragmented updates into a shared operating picture for cross-functional initiatives.

plugins.name: data-pipeline-analyst
plugins.description: Analytics engineer building reliable ETL pipelines, dashboards, and data quality checks on top of warehouse data.

plugins.name: data-privacy-compliance-officer
plugins.description: Privacy compliance officer reviewing data flows against GDPR/CCPA-style obligations and flagging gaps before they become incidents.

plugins.name: dataset-cleaner
plugins.description: Clean a messy dataset: standardize types, handle missing values deliberately, and log every transformation applied.

plugins.name: deal-desk-checklist
plugins.description: Review a proposed deal against discount and approval policy before it goes to signature.

plugins.name: dependency-vuln-triage
plugins.description: Scans package manifests and lockfiles across npm, pip, and Maven for known CVEs, then ranks each finding by exploitability, reachability in your code, and available patch path.

plugins.name: design-systems-specialist
plugins.description: Product designer building and maintaining component libraries, tokens, and accessibility standards at scale.

plugins.name: dockerfile-hardening-checker
plugins.description: Scans Dockerfiles and Compose files for insecure base images, root-user execution, exposed secrets, and missing multi-stage build patterns, then rewrites offending lines with hardened equivalents.

plugins.name: eval-set-forge
plugins.description: Builds structured evaluation datasets from raw production transcripts by clustering similar queries, sampling edge cases, and drafting rubric-based grading criteria.

plugins.name: executive-briefing-digest
plugins.description: Condense a long report or thread into a one-page executive brief with the decision and risk stated upfront.

plugins.name: feature-flag-rollout-planner
plugins.description: Plan a staged feature flag rollout with explicit rollback criteria and monitoring checkpoints per stage.

plugins.name: file-organizer-pro
plugins.description: Organize files and folders by understanding context and content, suggesting a clearer structure and flagging duplicates.

plugins.name: flaky-test-hunter
plugins.description: Identify flaky tests from CI history, isolate the non-determinism, and propose a fix instead of a blanket retry.

plugins.name: fpa-modeling-specialist
plugins.description: FP&A specialist building budget-vs-actual models, scenario plans, and board-ready financial packages.

plugins.name: fractional-cfo-advisor
plugins.description: Fractional CFO advisor building financial models, runway analysis, and board-ready reporting for growing companies.

plugins.name: growth-marketing-strategist
plugins.description: Growth strategist designing acquisition experiments, lifecycle funnels, and channel mix across paid and organic.

plugins.name: incident-response-threat-hunter
plugins.description: A senior incident responder who reconstructs attacker timelines from logs and EDR telemetry and turns each investigation into a lasting detection rule. Keeps containment decisive while preserving evidence for later analysis.

plugins.name: information-architecture-planner
plugins.description: Structures navigation, taxonomies, and content hierarchies so users can find what they need in two or three clicks, using card-sorting and tree-testing logic rather than guesswork.

plugins.name: infra-drift-detector
plugins.description: Compares a Terraform or Pulumi state file against the live cloud provider API to surface unmanaged changes, then generates a remediation plan to reconcile or import them.

plugins.name: infrastructure-as-code-architect
plugins.description: A senior cloud infrastructure architect who turns hand-run console changes into versioned, reviewable Terraform modules with drift detection built in. Specializes in multi-account AWS and GCP landing zones that survive team growth.

plugins.name: internal-change-comms-lead
plugins.description: Leads internal communication strategy for reorgs, restructurings, and major policy shifts, translating leadership decisions into messaging employees can trust and act on.

plugins.name: literature-review-assistant
plugins.description: Guide for structuring a literature review: source triage, claim mapping, and gap identification across academic and industry sources.

plugins.name: llm-eval-prompt-engineer
plugins.description: Builds rigorous eval harnesses and iterates on prompts with the discipline of an experimentalist, catching regressions that ad-hoc 'looks good to me' testing misses.

plugins.name: long-form-copywriter
plugins.description: Direct-response copywriter crafting landing pages, email sequences, and case studies that convert without hype.

plugins.name: market-research-analyst
plugins.description: Research analyst synthesizing competitive landscapes, customer interviews, and market sizing into decision-ready briefs.

plugins.name: meeting-notes-digest
plugins.description: Turn raw meeting notes or transcripts into decisions, action items with owners, and open questions.

plugins.name: ml-monitoring-drift-engineer
plugins.description: Keeps production models honest after launch by tracking feature drift, label delay, and silent performance decay before it shows up in business metrics.

plugins.name: mobile-bundle-size-audit
plugins.description: Analyzes an APK/AAB or IPA build artifact to break down size by module, asset type, and third-party library, then diffs against the previous release to flag regressions. Suggests concrete trims such as duplicate asset removal, unused resource stripping, and lazy-loadable modules.

plugins.name: onboarding-kit
plugins.description: A bundled collection of skills for new-hire onboarding: repo tour, glossary builder, and first-week task planner.

plugins.name: people-operations-coordinator
plugins.description: People operations coordinator building onboarding workflows, policy documentation, and clean org-change processes.

plugins.name: personal-productivity-coach
plugins.description: Productivity coach turning scattered task lists into prioritized, time-boxed plans that actually get finished.

plugins.name: policy-gap-analyzer
plugins.description: Compare an internal policy document against a named framework or checklist and report specific gaps.

plugins.name: prd-template-builder
plugins.description: Draft a structured PRD from a rough feature request: problem statement, scope, success metrics, and open questions.

plugins.name: process-improvement-analyst
plugins.description: Operations analyst mapping workflows, finding the real bottleneck, and designing SOPs people actually follow.

plugins.name: product-requirements-strategist
plugins.description: Senior product manager turning fuzzy feature requests into PRDs with explicit success metrics and scope boundaries.

plugins.name: prompt-chain-builder
plugins.description: Design multi-step prompt chains with explicit inputs/outputs per step, so failures are traceable to one stage.

plugins.name: prompt-regression-guard
plugins.description: Runs your prompt templates against a versioned snapshot suite before every deploy, diffing model outputs field-by-field to flag silent behavior drift.

plugins.name: proposal-pricing-table-generator
plugins.description: Build a pricing or tiering table for a sales proposal from a rate card and the deal's specific terms.

plugins.name: rag-pipeline-architect
plugins.description: Designs and hardens retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, from chunking strategy through reranking, for teams that need grounded answers instead of confident-sounding guesses.

plugins.name: regression-triage
plugins.description: Triage a reported regression: bisect the likely commit range, reproduce locally, and hand off with a minimal repro.

plugins.name: regulatory-change-monitor
plugins.description: Compliance analyst tracking relevant regulatory changes and translating them into concrete impact assessments.

plugins.name: rendering-strategy-engineer
plugins.description: Chooses and tunes the right rendering strategy—SSR, SSG, ISR, or client-only—on a per-route basis, and untangles hydration mismatches that only show up in production.

plugins.name: rest-api-scaffolder
plugins.description: Scaffold a REST resource end to end: route, handler, validation schema, and tests, following the project's existing conventions.

plugins.name: revenue-operations-analyst
plugins.description: RevOps analyst keeping pipeline data clean and forecasts honest instead of aspirational.

plugins.name: roadmap-prioritization-lead
plugins.description: Product operations lead running a defensible, ICE/RICE-scored backlog instead of a roadmap driven by whoever asked last.

plugins.name: sales-proposal-engineer
plugins.description: Sales engineer drafting RFP responses and proposals that answer the actual evaluation criteria instead of generic marketing copy.

plugins.name: secrets-and-cloud-security-engineer
plugins.description: A senior cloud security engineer who hunts down exposed credentials and over-privileged IAM before attackers do. Specializes in vaulting, key rotation, and closing the gap between granted and used permissions.

plugins.name: secrets-in-code-scanner
plugins.description: Sweeps repository history and working tree for hardcoded API keys, tokens, and credentials using entropy analysis and provider-specific pattern matching, then generates revocation steps.

plugins.name: security-questionnaire-responder
plugins.description: Drafts answers to vendor security questionnaires and SOC 2/ISO 27001 audit requests by pulling evidence from your existing policy docs, architecture diagrams, and control matrices.

plugins.name: site-reliability-engineer
plugins.description: A senior SRE who builds SLO-driven alerting and on-call runbooks so incidents get caught by symptoms, not guesswork. Treats error budgets as the shared contract between reliability work and feature velocity.

plugins.name: soc2-readiness-auditor
plugins.description: Compliance auditor mapping security controls to SOC 2 trust criteria and organizing evidence before the real audit starts.

plugins.name: social-crop-kit
plugins.description: Takes one source image and generates a full set of platform-ready crops (square, story, landscape, banner) using subject-aware framing so faces and focal points stay in frame.

plugins.name: sop-writer
plugins.description: Turn a described process into a numbered standard operating procedure with clear ownership at each step.

plugins.name: spreadsheet-insights
plugins.description: Turn a raw spreadsheet into a short set of defensible insights, with the underlying calculation shown for each claim.

plugins.name: stale-branch-cleanup-planner
plugins.description: Scans all local and remote branches to find ones already merged, abandoned for 60+ days, or orphaned from deleted PRs, then produces a safe-to-delete list with the evidence behind each entry. It never deletes anything itself; it only outputs the plan and the exact git commands to run.

plugins.name: strategic-narrative-coach
plugins.description: Executive communications coach shaping all-hands messaging and investor narrative around a consistent strategic story.

plugins.name: style-guide-enforcer
plugins.description: Check prose against a project or brand style guide: terminology, tone, formatting, and voice consistency.

plugins.name: technical-docs-writer
plugins.description: Produce API references, how-to guides, and conceptual docs that follow a consistent structure and stay honest about edge cases.

plugins.name: technical-seo-auditor
plugins.description: Elite technical SEO specialist auditing crawlability, Core Web Vitals, and structured data to recover organic visibility.

plugins.name: usability-heuristics-auditor
plugins.description: Runs structured heuristic evaluations against established usability principles and product-specific conventions, turning vague "this feels off" feedback into specific, prioritized usability findings.

plugins.name: user-research-ops-manager
plugins.description: Research operations manager running the recruiting, session logistics, and synthesis pipeline behind user research.

plugins.name: ux-writing-microcopy-specialist
plugins.description: Rewrites buttons, error messages, empty states, and confirmation dialogs so every word carries its weight, aligning tone and clarity across the entire product surface.

plugins.name: vendor-contract-tracker
plugins.description: Extract renewal dates, notice periods, and auto-renewal terms from contract text into a tracked summary.

plugins.name: vendor-management-specialist
plugins.description: Vendor management specialist tracking contracts, renewal dates, and spend so nothing auto-renews unnoticed.

plugins.name: web-perf-budget-keeper
plugins.description: Diagnoses and fixes real-world Core Web Vitals regressions—LCP, INP, CLS—by tracing render-blocking assets and JS execution cost back to the commits that introduced them.

plugins.name: workflow-automation-builder
plugins.description: Automation engineer wiring scripts, cron jobs, and no-code triggers into dependable, observable workflows.

plugins.name: youtube-script-planner
plugins.description: Plan a YouTube script with a retention-focused hook, timestamped beats, and a CTA placed where drop-off is lowest.

plugins.name: zettelkasten-notes
plugins.description: Capture atomic notes and link them into a Zettelkasten-style knowledge graph instead of a flat, unsearchable notes dump.
